summary: Validated the new per-program publisher breakdown end-to-end through the public API and browser. Sample and cumulative publisher_reports have the required All/B.Com/BBA/PGDM reports, exact totals, identical publisher sets, complete rows, and rightmost Total values. Program chips switch correctly, cumulative presets work, regressions/build pass, and 8/9 backend tests pass. One persistence/UI synchronization defect remains after saving publisher spend.

minor.issue: The patch recalculates result.publisher_report but does not update result.publisher_reports.All. This breaks the required legacy-equals-All invariant after a save; the returned and persisted objects differ in Amount Spent, Cost/Application, and Modified CPA rows.

integration_issues.issue: Save succeeds and shows the success toast, but the visible All-program publisher table remains stale. Reproduced with Collegedunia CPA 123: expected Amount Spent 5,412, displayed 0 because ReportTabs renders publisher_reports.All while the API updates only publisher_report.

issues: The From/To controls remain browser-native input[type=date] fields rather than the available shadcn calendar/date-range component.

action_items: In update_publisher_amounts, synchronize result.publisher_reports['All'] with the recalculated legacy publisher_report before persisting and returning the document; then verify the visible Amount Spent and Cost/Application rows update immediately after Save.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_publisher_amounts assigns result['publisher_report'] = pr but never assigns result['publisher_reports']['All'] = pr. Since ReportTabs intentionally prefers publisher_reports, the API response contains two contradictory All-publisher reports and the UI renders the stale one.

success_rate.backend: 88.9% (8/9 pytest cases; all new generation/cumulative totals and regressions pass except post-patch All synchronization)
success_rate.frontend: 94% (all requested navigation, filters, totals, panels, presets, and regressions passed; 1 post-save table synchronization failure)

seed_data_creation: Each backend run created two TEST-filter upload reports and one sample report; UI testing created one additional sample report. All test-created reports were deleted, global settings were restored, and the two pre-existing ready sample reports remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run backend_test.py; test_07 should pass once publisher_reports.All is synchronized. Browser E2E confirmed report History open, All/B.Com/BBA/PGDM APPLIED totals 126/14/41/71, per-row Total sums, cumulative PGDM total 27,904 and APPLIED 142, preset-year, Compare charts/table, Settings, Dashboard, and clean console. Frontend production build compiled successfully.
rca_of_the_issue: MongoDB deserialization gives publisher_report and publisher_reports.All separate nested objects. PATCH mutates only publisher_report. ReportTabs prefers publisher_reports and therefore renders its unchanged All report after setDoc receives the successful response. Assigning the recalculated object into both locations restores the invariant and visible state.
